summary: XCel Brands, Inc. filed Form 8-K to disclose an Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC, allowing the company to sell up to $10 million of common stock in at-the-market offerings. The offering is registered under an existing Form S-3 and the agent receives a 3% commission. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from ATM sales, but no strategic event or tender offer is involved.
